annotations.title: Auction lots and unsold rate for a district

description:
Auction lots for a postcode district (auctioneer, date, guide price, sold or
    not, hammer price where published) and the quarterly lots offered, sold and
    UNSOLD RATE. `since` is an ISO date.

    Do NOT use it for a discount to value or an AVM comparison: none is made, and a
    guide price is the auctioneer's. Only about a quarter of lots publish a
    hammer price and a fifth a yield (the auctioneer's own, labelled).
    Free.

    Auctions are indexed by postcode district: give an area of that type, a postcode or a UPRN; a local authority or a drawn
    shape returns covered=false with that reason. Rows with a UPRN carry `identity`. `place` is exactly one of {uprn}, {postcode}, {area: {type, code}} or {geometry} (point + radius_m up to 2000, bbox up to 5 km, polygon up to 200 vertices); free text is refused, call resolve_place first.
    UK only. Limits: 25 lots per page; more via `next_cursor`; a page is cut to 8 KB.
    A call with covered=false or an upstream failure is not charged.

PlaceArg.description: Exactly one of uprn, postcode, area, geometry. Free text is refused: call resolve_place first.
PlaceArg.title: PlaceArg

code.description: Lowercase postcode district ('e5') or an ONS/GSS code ('E09000012').
code.title: Code

_GeometryArg.description: One flat shape; set only the fields of its `type`.

bbox.description: bbox only: [min_lng, min_lat, max_lng, max_lat], at most 5 km across
bbox.title: Bbox

ring.description: polygon only: closed [lng, lat] ring, at most 200 vertices
ring.title: Ring
